requirements.requirement: Place the LTM at one end of the PC-104 stack because it does not pass PC-104 bus lines through.
Provide switched 5.0 V +/- 5% LTM power sized for approximately 2.9 W maximum draw.
Keep LTM unpowered until transmit-safe conditions are met and antennas are deployed.
Drive Umbilical Attached high when the USB umbilical is connected for bench operation and low in flight.
Expose the LIHU serial console/code-loader path through the spacecraft umbilical after integration.
Use CAN as the primary host interface with extended 29-bit identifiers; host sources for LTM commands should be 8 or above.
Treat optional I2C as LTM-master only; host-side devices must be compatible LTM-readable peripherals.
Provide 0-3.3 V analog telemetry inputs to LTM or tie unused telemetry inputs to ground.
Provide nominal 50 ohm VHF and UHF antenna paths from host antennas to the LTM coax/SMA interfaces.

board_observations: Copied board has legacy RFM98PW radio footprint U4 and MMCX RF connector RF1.
Copied board has RF_VCC net that can inform the switched-power pattern but needs power/current review for LTM.
Copied board has multiple I2C buses and reset/debug/umbilical-related circuitry that need mapping in the next schematic pass.
